summary:
Independent review of Jin Shu 86 owned units s0002–s0210 (s0140 absent) against the sealed Chinese, not the English glosses. Conventional Hui/Huai/Min/Yuan reign-year labels hold where the Chinese writes 永甯初, 永興中, 永嘉初, 湣帝即位, 建興初, 四載於茲, or 改年太興: Yongning 1 = AD 301, Yongxing = 304–306, Yongjia 1 = 307, Jianxing 1 = 313, Jianxing 4 = 316, Taixing 1 / Jianxing 6 = 318. Those are reign-year labels, not month/day Gregorian dates; Taishi 1 十二月丙寅 is already AD 266, which claim-566 correctly leaves unresolved. Undated-after-永嘉初 acts keep one-sided onOrAfter 307; post-湣帝即位 acts keep onOrAfter 313 without a false close. Gui's death stays an unresolved 313/314 competition from 在州十三年 versus conventional Jianxing 2; sui 60 is not turned into a birth year; 沒於賊 is not treated as death; 漢末 stays unresolved. Two chronology defects remain: the s0016 star-reading is closed to 301–301 without a year, and Qu Yun / Hu Song are closed to 316–316 despite 自去年九月. Eight explicit 死/斬/殺 deaths have attestation rows but no death predicate. Later reception (諡曰武公, speech-precedents, 討曹祛, 劉載) is kept off life dates. No research hold: the Chinese is enough to reject the closed years and to add the omitted deaths.
Owned units s0211–s0420 were read for omitted births, deaths, ages, and date context. Closed conversions that match the Jin era table are supported: 建興四年 = 316, 建興六年/太興元年 = 318, 太興三年 = 320, and 二年 after 建興初 as Jianxing 2 = 314. Ages 十歲, 年十八, and 年四十八 stay traditional-inclusive sui. Unresolved 建興初, 歲餘, 永昌初, 咸和初, the Taining 1/2/3 handover, the Fuhan/Wang Zhi block, and the undated heir/先是 rows are kept as competing or one-sided knowledge. Retrospective citations are not treated as living activity. Defects: the Shanggui 赴之 / Hexi 崩問 cluster is dated 316–318 despite s0234 是歲…建興六年; 明年/未幾 after 歲餘 after 太興三年 still includes 320; 歲餘 hints print 321–322 against their own unresolvedReason; Yin Jian borrows onOrBefore 320 that claim-446 forbids; Zhang Shi’s same-night killing of Liu Hong is left open after 318; deaths of Liu Hong, Yan Sha, and Jia Mo, and Mao’s 私諡曰成, are omitted. 42 item checks and 27 person checks are incorrect; the rest are supported.
Independent review of Jinshu 086 units s0421–s0629 against the owned claims. Numbered Jin reign years convert as conventional labels: 太興二年 = AD 319 (晉元帝), 咸和元年 = AD 326 / 八年 = 333 / 九年 = 334 (晉成帝), 永和元年 = AD 345 / 二年 = AD 346 (晉穆帝). Year-only labels are not treated as proleptic-Gregorian month/day dates; December of 咸和八年 or 永和元年 can spill into the next Western year, but no owned event gives a numbered month. 咸和初, 後, 至是, 建興中, 停梁州七年, and the long 永和二年 sequel are correctly one-sided (onOrAfter) and, on living and death rows, unresolved. 劉曜’s killing, 張駿’s death window after 永和元年 and before 永和二年, and 張重華’s 將受詔未及而卒 are not closed from later tradition (AD 329 / 353). Named deaths and sui ages in the owned units are present and not converted to birth years; 同生 is not at issue. Reception of ancient exemplars and posthumous 追諡 / 追崇 is kept off active hints. Eighteen retrospective citation claims reuse 後 or the 永和元年/二年 cluster with the right one-sided Western floor but omit unresolved:true and unresolvedReason, which the matching living host claims already carry.
Independent review of Jinshu 86 owned units s0630–s0841 (plus s0842) covering 耀靈, 祚, 玄靚, and 天錫. Chinese era anchors were read first. Year-only Western labels follow 穆帝永和十年 = AD 354, equated in-chapter with 建興四十二年/和平元年; 建興四十三年 = 355; 建興四十九年/奉升平 = 361; 興寧元年 = 363; 太和初 as onOrAfter 366; 太元元年 = 376; 淮肥 as 太元八年 = 383; 隆安中 = 397–401. These are conventional regnal-year labels, not month/day proleptic-Gregorian dates; Academia Sinica Julian/Gregorian switch is irrelevant here. Ages 十歲/年十四/十八九/年六十一 are preserved without birth-year conversion. Posthumous 賜諡, Heping 追崇, 故太尉 citation, 追贈, and the historian's appraisal stay retrospective and off the active-hint lists. Undated Lian Qi/Li Yan fighting and 立子大懷 correctly remain unresolved between 太和初 and 太元元年, refusing ZZTJ 367 / 晉記 368. Zuo's fall stays 354–355 with ZZTJ 永和十一年閏月 held as a competing witness. Tianxi's 尋卒 after 桓玄時 stays unresolved (no 義熙二年). One defect: p311 張瓘 is destroyed in s0713 共討瓘，盡夷其屬 with no death claim. p279 重華母馬氏 and p301 駿妻馬氏 are left as separate IDs; unmarked s0717 馬氏 is not identified. Split section IDs (祚 p287/p304, 天錫 p291/p306/p332, 軌 p271/p331/p364) are locally coherent.

references.title: 大兴 (东晋) — 维基百科
references.quote: 大兴（或作太兴； 318年三月—321年）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第二个年号，共计4年。
references.reason: Confirms 太興/大興 as 晉元帝’s era, AD 318–321, so 二年 = 319. The chapter writes 太興二年.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋) — 维基百科
references.quote: 建兴（ 313年四月—317年三月）是西晋皇帝晉愍帝司馬鄴的年号，共计5年。
references.reason: Confirms 建興 of 晉愍帝 opens AD 313 and runs into 317; 建興中 is a mid-era label, not a closed year, and is not Former Liang’s long 建興 count.

references.title: 中国历代年号索引表 (IHNS)

references.title: 永和 (东晋)
references.quote: 永和（ 345年—356年）是东晋皇帝晉穆帝司馬聃的第一个年号
references.reason: Confirms 穆帝永和 is AD 345–356, so the chapter's 永和十年 is the conventional AD 354 year label. Year-only; not a month/day Gregorian event date.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 永嘉七年（313年）四月二十七日，改元為建興元年。
references.reason: Confirms 愍帝建興元年 is AD 313, the count Former Liang continues. Combined with s0842+s0655, 建興四十二年 = 和平元年 = 永和十年 = AD 354.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建興四十二年（354年）正月，張祚改元為和平元年。
references.reason: Agrees with Jinshu s0655 that 建興四十二年 was changed to 和平元年 in AD 354. Conventional year label.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 和平二年（355年），張玄靚廢除和平年號，復稱建興四十三年。
references.reason: Agrees with s0699 復稱建興四十三年 as AD 355. ZZTJ's 永和十一年閏月 remains a competing witness, not a Jinshu sourceDate.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建興四十九年（361年）十二月，張玄靚停用建興年號，改稱升平五年。
references.reason: Agrees with s0740 改建興四十九年，奉升平之號 as the conventional AD 361 year.

references.title: 兴宁 (东晋)
references.quote: 兴宁（ 363年二月—365年）是東晋皇帝晉哀帝司馬丕的第二个年号
references.reason: Confirms 哀帝興寧元年 is AD 363 for s0741–s0752.

references.title: 太和 (东晋)
references.quote: 太和（ 366年—371年十一月），一作泰和
references.reason: Confirms 海西公太和 begins AD 366, so 太和初 is onOrAfter 366 rather than a certified single year.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元（ 376年—396年）是東晋皇帝晋孝武帝司马曜的第二个年号
references.reason: Confirms 孝武帝太元 is AD 376–396, so 太元元年 is the conventional AD 376 year label.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 寧康四年（376年）正月三日，改元為太元元年。
references.reason: Confirms the 太元元年 reform is AD 376 (from 寧康四年).

references.title: 淝水之戰 - 教育部《重編國語辭典》修訂本
references.quote: 孝武帝太元八年（西元383）戰於淝水
references.reason: s0805 writes 淮肥 with no era year. This dictionary entry dates 淝水 to 孝武帝太元八年 AD 383. Year-only conversion; Jinshu still lacks a month/day.

references.title: 隆安 (東晉)
references.quote: 隆安（或作崇安；（397年—401年））是東晉皇帝晉安帝司馬德宗的第一個年號
references.reason: Confirms 安帝隆安 is AD 397–401, the interval used for s0817 隆安中.
